BL-0.1.4-010-S1.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Configuration Contract
BL-0.1.4-010-S1.description: Define configuration schema for Mongo cluster routing including cluster identifiers, environment mapping, read/write roles, and failover rules. Ensure compatibility with existing Mongo utilities and environment prefix routing.

BL-0.1.4-010-S2.title: Implement Cluster Routing Decision Engine
BL-0.1.4-010-S2.description: Build core logic to select the correct MongoDB cluster at runtime based on request context (environment, data domain, operation type). Ensure deterministic routing and enforce separation between clusters.

BL-0.1.4-010-S3.title: Integrate Routing Logic into Mongo Utilities Layer
BL-0.1.4-010-S3.description: Integrate cluster routing engine into shared Mongo utilities so all database access paths automatically resolve to the correct cluster without requiring changes in domain services.

BL-0.1.4-010-S4.title: Add Observability and Safeguards for Cluster Routing
BL-0.1.4-010-S4.description: Implement logging and validation to detect misrouting, cross-cluster access violations, and fallback conditions. Include debug logs aligned with existing debug_logger patterns and enforce visibility across backend services and pipeline interactions.

BL-0.1.4-010-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
BL-0.1.4-010-S5.description: Create tests validating correct cluster selection, isolation between clusters, and failure scenarios (misconfiguration, unavailable cluster). Include integration tests with Mongo utilities.
